name: Custom Modulation Analysis
description: Ability to identify and characterize non-standard, proprietary, or custom modulation schemes encountered in security assessments. Covers modulation classification from blind signal captures, parameter estimation (symbol rate, carrier offset, roll-off), constellation analysis, and development of custom demodulation approaches for previously unseen modulation types.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to custom modulation analysis

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands modulation scheme diversity and the challenge of non-standard modulations
evidence: Can describe the properties that distinguish major modulation families (ASK, FSK, PSK, QAM, spread-spectrum)
Understands how modulation parameters affect spectral shape and time-domain characteristics
Completed training on modulation classification fundamentals

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Assists in characterizing unknown modulations using analysis tools under supervision
evidence: Used spectral and time-domain analysis to distinguish modulation families under guidance
Estimated symbol rates from cyclostationary features or eye diagram analysis with assistance
Identified constellation diagrams and mapped them to modulation orders under supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently classifies and characterizes non-standard modulation schemes
evidence: Independently classified modulation schemes from 3+ blind signal captures
Estimated symbol rate, carrier offset, and excess bandwidth from captured signals
Developed custom demodulation approaches for non-standard modulations
Documented modulation parameters with sufficient detail for independent reproduction

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Characterizes complex modulation schemes; develops automated classification approaches
evidence: Characterized multi-carrier, spread-spectrum, or hybrid modulation schemes from blind captures
Developed automated or semi-automated modulation classification tools for the lab
Resolved challenging cases with low SNR, interference, or partial captures
Mentors junior analysts on modulation characterization methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on modulation analysis; publishes research; defines lab capability
evidence: Published research on modulation classification or blind signal analysis techniques
Characterized modulation schemes that had not been previously publicly documented
Authored the lab's modulation analysis methodology and reference library
Trains teams on advanced modulation analysis techniques

assessment_methods.description: Given blind IQ captures of signals with non-standard modulations, classify each modulation type, estimate parameters, and produce demodulated output
Develop a demodulation approach for a previously uncharacterized modulation scheme from a captured signal
